note: Thomas weaves Scripture into his sentences, usually from the Latin Vulgate and almost never with a reference (the English cites only John 8:12). Where he quotes a verse and Van Dyck (1865, ebible arb-vd, via the GitHub mirror arb_vdv, since Take Root is egress-blocked) says the same, Van Dyck is pasted byte-for-byte, vocalised, inside « »; where his wording follows the Vulgate, re-persons or re-aims the verse, or is an unmarked echo in his prose, it is rendered from the English, unvocalised, and marked self_rendered. Mined rows were measured: a span of the verse of at least 15 characters is a byte substring of the chapter.

AI-translated (job #7656) in sixteen parallel chapter ranges against one shared conventions file, then reconciled. Deuterocanonical quotations (Sirach, Wisdom, 2 Maccabees) have no Van Dyck text and are always self_rendered. Awaiting native review.
